snippet.title: Summer Memories+ - Expansion DLC - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Were there not enough memories to be made in the original? Don't worry, we agree!

From the developer, Dojin Otome, comes an expansion DLC for our hit game, Summer Memories!

Unlock new memories with added scenes for all the characters.

Enjoy some new interactions and voices, including with side characters and more!

Summer Memories+ - Expansion DLC coming to Steam soon https://store.steampowered.com/app/1390150/Summer_Memories__Expansion_DLC/
